Name: Delores - Custom NPC
Author: blaaze6
Description:
[code]﻿[/code][img]https://images2.imgbox.com/60/bc/bwaw6qLc_o.png[/img]﻿[center]A fitness freak, a vegan, a teetotaler, and a hipster walks into Gus's bar. She orders a salad to go, as she has to bike back to her shared apartment in ZuZu City.

[size=5]Meet [color=#3c78d8][b]Delores[/b][/color]![/size]

She comes with complete dialogue, marriage dialogue, a spouse room, and a year-round schedule of exercise! A relatively outgoing girl, can you find out why she shuts down in autumn? Can you figure out why she dislikes her roommates so much? And can you look past the awkward first steps and find the Aquamarine gem inside of her? (Speaking of awkward, that was a weird phrasing)

In addition to all mentioned above, Delores also comes with 6 heart events! One of them even takes you on an 80s style exercise montage with her!
[size=5][b]

[size=2][b]Loves[/b]: Aquamarine, Salad, Vegetable Medley, Red Plate, Roots Platter, Kale, Blueberry, Energy Tonic, Muscle Remedy, Green Tea
[b]Likes[/b]: Green Bean, Cauliflower, Bread, Fiddlehead Fern, Red Cabbage, Common Mushroom, Summer Spangle, Dandelion
[b]Neutral[/b]: Bone Flute, Prismatic Shard, Pancakes

[/size][color=#f1c232][color=#ffffff][color=#ea9999][size=4][b]Movie Theater Preferences[/b][/size][/color]

[*][size=2][b]4 Heart Event[/b]: In Town on a Sunny Day between 8:00 am and 5:00 pm[/size]
[*][size=2][b]6 Heart Event[/b]: In Cindersap Forest on a Sunday in Fall between 8:00 am and 5:00 pm (I'd recommend completing it before marrying her.)[/size]
[*][size=2][b]8 Heart Event[/b]: On the Beach between 8:00 am and 5:00 pm (Need to have seen 4 Heart Event)[/size]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[size=3]Have the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher, then you put this mod's folder, which is named [b][CP][/b] [b]Delores[/b], in your StardewValley\Mods folder.[/size]
